integrity: The proof is self-contained up to the stated standard Pell companion definitions; direct exact-integer checks are supplementary. Prior 2023 empirical relations are explicitly credited.
limitations: Only three of four balancing-related square-window families are classified; the residual gcd(k,B_k) is not eliminated, and no claim of complete literature coverage or independent validation is made.
title: Three balancing-family square-window gcds in terms of one index divisor
